name: 993 oval exhaust tip in IN625, F0 twin

coordinate_system.origin: center of the hypothetical F0 inlet
coordinate_system.axes: X width, Y height, Z flow direction toward the outlet

interfaces.acceptance_rule: The measured slip fit, clamping and sealing meet the approved tolerances without parasitic stress.
A pulsed compressible CFD, correlated with measurements, meets the approved back-pressure and thermal criteria.
Hot clearances, temperatures, vibration and acoustic emissions stay within the approved criteria over the life cycle.

known_limits: Only the 120 x 85 mm outlet envelope is published; inlet, length, double walls, attachments and interfaces are F0 assumptions.
The steady RANS CFD uses a synthetic flow rate and synthetic properties; the pressure-loss convergence between the two finest meshes misses the project threshold of 10%.
The extended mesh checks still show low-determinant cells, with no negative volume and no standard checkMesh failure.
The full-part slicing finds a computable orientation and support proxies, but no complete process map, distortion simulation or recoater collision check is available.
The USD passes the SimReady validators as an isolated rigid prop; neither the exhaust-to-valance assembly, nor thermal behavior, nor vehicle vibration is tested.
The PhysicsNeMo smoke test proves only the CUDA runtime; no surrogate model is trained or used as physical evidence.
No manufacturing, installation or vehicle use is authorized.
